hero.title: Dival Sehgal

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years building full-stack web applications end to end — performant React/Next.js frontends, GraphQL and REST APIs, serverless functions, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.

Recently I've been orchestrating data from multiple backend services into federated GraphQL layers with AWS AppSync and Python/Lambda, architecting TypeScript monorepos with Turborepo, and building multi-brand eCommerce platforms and data-driven dashboards.

I also design AI-assisted development workflows — Copilot, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers wired into Figma and Jira/Azure DevOps — to cut the distance between design and shipped code.
Outside of work, I hike and spend time in national parks and wildlife sanctuaries — it's where I go to reset and come back to hard problems with a clearer head.

experience.company: EPAM Systems — Clients: Philips Healthcare, Princess Auto

description.text: Built healthcare web applications for Philips Healthcare with Next.js and Contentful CMS, orchestrating data from multiple backend services into a unified AWS AppSync GraphQL layer.
Built and extended AppSync GraphQL resolvers in Python on AWS Lambda, transforming Contentful content into a federated, strongly-typed GraphQL schema.

Led a 3-engineer team on a Contentful CMS migration for Princess Auto (Canadian retail chain), giving marketing independent control of 100% of dynamic site content across listings, showcases, guides, campaigns, and recommendation modules.

Standardized AI-assisted development workflows using Copilot, Claude Code, MCP servers, and reusable prompt/skill files, speeding up code generation and design-to-code delivery across Jira/Azure DevOps.
Architected a TypeScript monorepo (Turborepo) with shared design tokens and a component library in Storybook, improving consistency and accessibility across applications.
Built scheduled Azure Functions that auto-generate XML sitemaps for large-scale product and category inventory, improving SEO crawl efficiency.
Re-architected the Advisor Dashboard into a real-time analytics platform, using Hotjar data to guide UX changes that drove a 25% increase in engagement.
Modernized the Advisor Onboarding Flow, migrating from Ember.js to Next.js and integrating Tipalti and Jumio for automated tax and identity compliance.
Consolidated Feedback, Availability Manager, and Customer Support into one unified experience, using pub/sub and polling for real-time chat availability.
Integrated a Zendesk chatbot into the support flow, cutting manual response overhead.
Led the Shukran Delivery Project for Max Fashion and Home Centre, rolling out same-day delivery across multiple store locations and driving a 25% increase in non-GDMS orders.
Built personalized banners in Amplience CMS, segmented by user landing source and behavior, with Monetate powering variant injection and A/B testing in production without engineering deployments.
Redesigned flash-sales and recommendation-rail UX, driving a 30% increase in engagement across all Landmark brands.
Revamped store-locator and product-listing filters, improving accessibility and discoverability by 20%.
Ran Lighthouse audits to cut page load time and cumulative layout shift, reducing bounce rate by 10%.
Built a KYC Dashboard for Stanza Living, centralizing 10,000–50,000 monthly booking requests across multiple apps and integrating the Aadhaar API for real-time identity verification.
Built an Ad Campaign Dashboard managing 1,000+ monthly campaigns with performance tracking and workflow automation, cutting manual overhead by ~30%.
Architected role-based routing and an atomic component structure for Narayan Edtech's platform, enabling scalable feature development.
Built an internal Shuttle Service app with an admin dashboard for managing client visits, ride-sharing, cab bookings, and seat allocation.
